summary: This bill expands TRICARE Prime and TRICARE Select to cover fertility-related care, including in vitro fertilization (IVF) with specific limits on oocyte retrievals and embryo transfers, for active duty service members and their dependents, while prohibiting coverage for certain reproductive technologies.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly amends Title 10 of the U.S. Code, which pertains to the Armed Forces, to expand TRICARE coverage for fertility treatments for active duty military members and their dependents. This represents an increase in benefits and associated costs within the military healthcare system, thus increasing military spending.
